plugin.description: Shows live market prices for rewards inside the Ritual window.
debug.inventories_help: Showing all active ServerData PlayerInventories with >0 items.
settings.diagnose_help: When on, every ritual tile is labelled with its rarity, the base name read from memory, the final lookup name, and the internal id. Tiles with no price show a red 'NO PRICE'.
settings.display_help: Prices are shown as value + currency orb icon (no background box).
settings.footer_help: This plugin reads items from the Ritual shop (Favours window) and displays prices on each item.
settings.force_bfs_help: Bypass the fast index chain and always locate the ritual window via the signature BFS fallback. Normally the fallback only engages if the index chain breaks after a patch.
settings.naming_help: All items (currency and uniques) are named automatically from game memory. Prices come from poe2scout + poe.ninja; items missing there show no label (trade tools may differ).
settings.price_source_help: Prices are estimates from poe2scout / poe.ninja (not live trade). Uniques use the higher of scout and ninja. Refresh after league economy shifts.
